candidates.snippet: Zelensky says the constant terror in recent days is Putin’s new tactic ahead of the elections, and Ukraine will respond. He also says Ukraine, the US, and Europe will discuss new ideas on ending the war next week.

Kushner says Trump tasked him and Witkoff with building a "peace package" to end the war. He says Trump wants a lasting peace mechanism, not just a pause. Kushner adds the vice president and Secretary of State Marco Rubio are working on it too. https://t.co/8YrprY6iXy
Zelensky thanked Trump’s envoys for coming to Ukraine. "You worked even better than Patriot systems," he said. "Come more often, and our people will get a chance to live a little."
